published_ranges._notes: Current official page: layer height 0.2 mm; bed surface tape or glue. UL94 V-0 (Kexcelled K's Lab blog). The 320 C upper bound is above the X1/P1 limit; Bambu's own PPS-CF store page says 'For X1E/H2 Series Printing Only' and 'All AMS Series NOT Compatible' (nozzle 310-340 C, bed 100-120 C, drying 100-140 C 8-12 h).
